$comment: Watched-flags config for the flag-rollout guardrail (.github/workflows/flag-rollout-guardrail.yml).
Each entry is a flag whose live PostHog SLOs are polled; on an SLO breach the guardrail
halts the ramp (sets rollout_percentage to 0) or fully disables the flag via the PostHog API.
HOW ATTRIBUTION WORKS
Call sites MUST wrap flag-gated code with withFlag(key, fn) from @borradh-workspace/observability.
This stamps feature_flag_key on every trackedResult/tracked PostHog event inside that scope.
The guardrail queries only events tagged with each flag's own key, so a breach on flag A
never triggers a rollback of flag B.
Pattern at every gate site:
if (await isFeatureOn('my-flag')) {
return withFlag('my-flag', () => newCodePath());
return oldCodePath();
FIELDS
key            (string)  PostHog flag key.
flagId         (number)  PostHog numeric feature-flag id (from the flag URL). Required to PATCH.
enabled        (boolean) Whether the guardrail evaluates this flag. false = skipped.
owner          (string)  Flag owner — must have an expiry + cleanup PR planned.
expiry         (string)  ISO date the flag is expected to be removed by (audit only).
lookbackHours  (number)  Window the SLO query measures over (default 2).
action         (string)  'halt' (rollout_percentage -> 0) or 'disable' (active -> false).
thresholds     (object)  SLO bounds:
maxErrorRate   breach if flag-on error rate exceeds this (fraction, e.g. 0.05)
maxP95Ms       breach if flag-on p95 latency exceeds this (ms)
minConversion  breach if a key conversion rate falls below this (fraction)
minSampleSize  below this many events the window is ignored
conversionEvent (string, optional) PostHog event name for the conversion check.
